limits: This is a semantic-role migration; baseline dot contrast already passed3:1. Do not describe the evidence as fixing a reproduced WCAG threshold failure.

No model execution was required or performed. First Before and After runs had no LLM API key. Parent configured its baseline LLM before corrected light-theme captures; no model call was made and the health-dot rendering does not consume model configuration.

Live representative surfaces are Manage Backends rows and installed MCP health cards. Existing focused tests cover selector, edit, API-key/retry and cloud remote/stdio visibility branches. No authenticated Cloud, ACP session or custom embedded-host visual pass is claimed.

Expected requests to stopped secondary endpoints generate network/CORS diagnostics. Main stacks passed doctor before/after capture. MCP missing-command test is an expected backend-level failure, not a simulated response.

superseded.reason: Launching the after stack reused the first stopped secondary port18810 before the final two Before themes completed. Original Light+/Solarized backend shots therefore show genuine wrong-API-key disconnection with a version badge, rather than the intended network-refused state. These eight original light-theme shots remain on disk and are excluded from the paired comparison. Eight before-corrected shots on distinct stopped18830 replace them; three original dark themes and the initial Before raw video retain genuine network failure.
superseded.publication: Original wrong-cause Light+/Solarized screenshots are excluded. Public matrices use corrected, paired captures on the distinct stopped endpoint.

summary: Semantic-role migration to existing status-error fill. Baseline already met 3:1; minimum sampled nontext contrast changes from 3.107 to 3.774 across 40 selected screenshots.

implementation.behavior: Theme-owned failure dots retain actual failed/disconnected states, labels and controls.
